change.after: "returns the results of the most recent cached probe"

original.statement: The cilium-health status --probe flag no longer runs synchronous probes; it now returns cached results and is hidden, scheduled for removal in a future release.

decision.reason: [ev-5f4aedc964f4] says `cilium-health status --probe` no longer runs a synchronous probe and now returns the results of the most recent cached probe. So the subject is the --probe flag of cilium-health, and the change is to its behavior. The flag also becoming hidden and slated for removal is secondary; it is not a plain deprecation, because the old behavior no longer works. The before/after values match the note (the "after" value is the note's exact words).
